items.source: Condition that matches if either: The property spring.ai.vectorstore.opensearch.aws.enabled is explicitly set to false. Required AWS SDK classes are missing from the classpath.
items.translation: 满足以下任一条件时： - 属性 `spring.ai.vectorstore.opensearch.aws.enabled` 被显式设置为 `false`。 - 类路径中缺少必需的 AWS SDK 类。
